supersessions.changed_meaning: The required independent assessment subject broadens from exact live code to the exact live realisation under the selected computational binding. The software case retains its obligations; a human or mixed realisation can supply the exact performed operations without an invented code requirement. Exact subject, authority paths, proof, installed subject, independence and separate decision authority remain. This changed latitude is proposed, not accepted by the general common binding requirement.

Before publishing a review or handoff, apply Workspace and context to its bound subject and basis and report any judgment through the complete core result, allowing a concise sufficient reference. These acquisition and judgment-record obligations are additions to the predecessor posting boundary, not merely a relocation of its prose conventions. Commentary still cannot supply an absent decision.

Before revising an owning surface, apply workspace-derived acquisition; a writing review uses the core result on the actual preservation or style predicate. These acquisition and judgment-record obligations are additions to the predecessor practical writing checks. Shorter text establishes neither preservation nor style satisfaction; existing owning authority and predecessor disposition requirements remain.

ticket_extension: The predecessor requirement to log admission in runtime/event truth becomes recording in the selected work carrier, including an event log only when that is its declared realisation. Availability to prompt assembly becomes availability to frame or prompt assembly. This carrier and assembly latitude is part of proposed I3-R2-R025 and requires its owner decision; the contract/admission distinctions and result-algebra changes already recorded remain.

ux_reserved_question.question: Which accepted determination replaces the three compliance tests and their closure obligations? The tests remain source-preserved; the existing 1A fail-closed rule governs current ambiguity. This question is separate from outcome/replay proposals.
